pride_data.title: PrimPol primase mediates replication traverse of DNA interstrand crosslinks
pride_data.projectDescription: Human cancer cells rely on PRIMPOL primase activity to mediate ICL traverse, sustain DNA synthesis and complete DNA replication
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Immunoprecipitation. 8M Urea 100mM Tris-HCl elution. FASP digestion Lysc-Trypsin. Stage-Tip c18 desalting. LC-MSMS analysis Orbitrap-Velos
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw data was analyzed by MaxQuant against a H. sapiens database supplemented with the sequences of the contaminants most frequently detected in the proteomics lab (UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot, 20,599 sequences). Minimal peptide length was set to 6 amino acids and a maximum of two missed cleavages were allowed. Peptides and proteins were filtered at 1% false discovery rate (FDR). Student’s T-test statistics were used for determining the significance of the intensity of each protein.
